columns.description: Metadata for each column in the PCS database CSV

Physical_Effect.description: Physical effect of the PCS. Must be one or more: Convective, Conductive, Radiant, Evaporative.

Type.description: Type of PCS (e.g., fan, foot warmer).

Size.description: PCS dimensions in the following format: height, length, width (cm)

Brand.description: Brand name of the PCS. If it is a prototype, give it a name.

PCS_Reference.description: Reference product URL or project landing page.

Image_Path.description: Name of the image file of the PCS in JPEG or PNG format (preference for high resolution 300dpi)

Publication.description: DOI or URL for a publication where this data is presented.

PCS_Level.description: Selected level for the test/total PEC control available levels. Example, for a fan with 10 speed levels, level 3 is selected: 3/10.

Price_USD.description: Price of the PCS in US dollars.

Angle.description: Angle of the PCS and target (degrees).

Target_Body.description: Targeted body segment for PCS application.

Place.description: Location where the measurement was taken.

Posture.description: Posture of the manikin during measurement (e.g., standing, sitting).

Situation.description: Description of the environment where PCS is used (e.g., office, car).

Manikin_Company.description: Manufacturer of the thermal manikin used.

Manikin_Gender.description: Gender representation of the thermal manikin.

Manikin_Body_Segments.description: Number of body segments of the thermal manikin.

Control_Method.description: Method used to control the PCS (e.g., manual, automatic).

Delta_Teq_.description: Change in equivalent temperature for each body part.

Delta_P_.description: Change in power supply from the manikin for each body part.

Clo_.description: Clothing insulation for each body part.

Condition_without_PCS.description: File path to the raw data without PCS.

Condition_with_PCS.description: File path to the raw data with PCS.
